title: Causation: A Critical Link in Commercial Damage Opinions
summary: Commercial damages experts must distinguish between assuming liability and establishing causation—while they may assume wrongful conduct occurred, they must still rigorously evaluate whether that conduct actually caused the specific economic harm claimed and account for alternative factors that may have contributed to the financial losses.
body_markdown: A commercial damages expert may be asked to quantify the economic harm sustained by one party because of the actions of another. As a forensic accountant responsible for quantifying damages, it is also our job to keep things simple—explain complex situations in a not so complex way.
